prompt: An agent is generating code changes across 10 repositories simultaneously in a multi-agent workflow. After deployment, a critical bug is traced to one of the agent-generated changes. What capability must have been implemented in advance to support rapid diagnosis?
explanation: Correct answer: B) Traceability and accountability — inspectable artifacts and logs linking each action to a specific agent and task

options.text: Traceability and accountability — inspectable artifacts and logs linking each action to a specific agent and task
